left out, to write by hand:
  provider.logs.restApi: the routes of the rest api are on the http api: give it access logs with http.accessLogs
  provider.logs.websocket: koldstart has no access logs of the websocket api yet
  functions.charge.provisionedConcurrency: koldstart publishes no versions yet, which provisioned concurrency needs
  functions.settle.events[1].consumer: koldstart has no consumer yet
  functions.settle.snapStart: koldstart publishes no versions yet, which snapStart needs

works differently, to check:
  provider.tracing.apiGateway: an http api has no x-ray tracing: the functions trace with tracing
  functions.audit.events[2].deadLetterQueueArn: the queue's policy must let events.amazonaws.com send to it

not needed in koldstart:
  provider.logs.frameworkLambda: koldstart deploys no functions of its own
